# Segmentation settings QC - 

Here, we used different settings for deep-learning based single-cell segmentation (see `RCC_steinbock_prepro.md`). 

Mesmer:
**masks_1** = *Irdium 191/193,* CA9, panCK, Vimentin, SMA, CD8a, CD68   

Nuclear detection and expansion:
**masks_exp** = *Irdium 191/193,* + Expansion by maximum of 3 pixels

CellPose: 
**masks_cp_1** = *Irdium 191/193,* CA9, panCK, Vimentin, SMA, CD8a, CD68  

## Software requirements

```{r lib, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
#Data containers
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(SingleCellExperiment)

#Data processing
library(CATALYST)
library(scuttle)
library(scater)
library(imcRtools)

#Data visualization
library(cytomapper)
library(dittoSeq)
library(viridis)

#Utilities
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(stringr)
library(BiocParallel)
```

## Read in images

```{r}
#Load images
images <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/images.rds")
images
```

To correctly scale pixel values of the segmentation masks (contains cell_ids) when reading them in set `as.is = TRUE`.

```{r read-images}
#Load masks
masks_1 <- loadImages("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/masks_1/", as.is = TRUE)
masks_1 

masks_exp <- loadImages("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/masks_exp/", as.is = TRUE)
masks_exp

masks_cp_1 <- loadImages("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/masks_cp_1/", as.is = TRUE)
masks_cp_1

masks_cp <- loadImages("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/masks/", as.is = TRUE)
masks_cp
```

```{r}
# Safety checks
all.equal(names(images), names(masks_1))
all.equal(names(images), names(masks_exp))
all.equal(names(images), names(masks_cp_1))
```

Add additional metadata to the `elementMetadata` slot of the `CytoImageList` (accessible via mcols)

```{r add-image-metadata}
# Read in external metadata
patient_meta <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC.csv",col_names = TRUE)
patient_meta$TMA_id <- str_replace(paste0(patient_meta$grid,"x",patient_meta$x,"y",patient_meta$y),"NA","")
patient_meta$TMA_id <- str_replace(patient_meta$TMA_id, "x","X")
patient_meta$TMA_id <- str_replace(patient_meta$TMA_id, "y","Y")
patient_meta[is.na(patient_meta$x),]$TMA_id <- "CX7Y8" #was missing in data

# Read in images
images_meta <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/images.csv",col_names = TRUE)
images_meta$names <- str_split(images_meta$image,".tiff",simplify = TRUE)[,1]
images_meta$TMA_id <- str_split(images_meta$acquisition_description," ",simplify = TRUE)[,1]

# Add information to metadata of CytoImageList
mcols(images)$sample_id <- images_meta$names[match(names(images),images_meta$names)]
mcols(images)$TMA_id <- images_meta$TMA_id[match(names(images),images_meta$names)]

mcols(images)$PID <- patient_meta$PID[match(mcols(images)$TMA_id,patient_meta$TMA_id)]
mcols(images)$type <- patient_meta$type[match(mcols(images)$TMA_id,patient_meta$TMA_id)]
mcols(images)$subtype <- patient_meta$subtype[match(mcols(images)$TMA_id,patient_meta$TMA_id)]

# Transfer to masks objects as well
mcols(masks_1) <- mcols(masks_exp) <- mcols(masks_cp_1) <- mcols(images)
```

```{r save-objects-read-data}
saveRDS(masks_1, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/masks_1.rds")
```

## Segmentation quality control - A

```{r}
images <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/images.rds")
```

A: Using `cytoviewer`

```{r}
library(cytoviewer)

cytoviewer(image = images, mask = masks_1, img_id = "sample_id")
```

B: `plotPixels` function from [cytomapper](https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/cytomapper.html).

```{r overlay-masks, message=FALSE}
# 1. Subset to ccRCC 
images <- images[!is.na(mcols(images)$subtype)]
images_ccRCC <- images[mcols(images)$subtype == "clear_cell_RCC"]

#Randomly select 30 images
set.seed(220195)
img_random <- sample(seq_len(length(images_ccRCC)), 30)

# Normalize and clip image
cur_images <- images_ccRCC[img_random]
cur_images <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images, separateImages = TRUE)
cur_images <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images, inputRange = c(0, 0.2))

# Generate and save images
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
registerDoParallel(cores = 20)

masks_options <- c("masks_1", "masks_exp", "masks_cp_1")

foreach(i = masks_options)%dopar%{

# Subset masks
cur_masks <- get(i)
cur_masks <- cur_masks[mcols(cur_masks)$sample_id %in% mcols(cur_images)$sample_id]
cur_masks <- cur_masks[match(names(cur_images), names(cur_masks))]

plotPixels(cur_images,
           mask = cur_masks,
           img_id = "sample_id",
           colour_by = c("DNA1", "CA9", "SMA","CD8a","CD68"),
           colour = list("DNA1" = c("black", "yellow"),
                         "CA9" = c("black", "magenta"),
                         "SMA" = c("black", "cyan"),
                         "CD8a" = c("black","red"),
                         "CD68" = c("black","green")
                         ),
           thick = FALSE,
           image_title = NULL,
           legend = list(colour_by.title.cex = 0.7,
                         colour_by.labels.cex = 0.7),
           save_plot = list(filename = paste0("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/seg_test/", i,".png"), scale = 2))
}
```


**Key Observations:**
1. Nuclear expansion and CellPose (slightly preferred) looks best and we will have a closer look at single-cell expression below. 

## Read in single-cell information

### steinbock generated data

```{r read and inspect steinbock}
sce_exp <- read_steinbock("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/",intensities_folder = "intensities_exp",return_as = "sce",regionprops_folder = NULL, graphs_folder = NULL)

sce_cp_1 <- read_steinbock("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/",intensities_folder = "intensities_cp_1",return_as = "sce",regionprops_folder = NULL, graphs_folder = NULL)

dim(assay(sce_exp,"counts"))
dim(assay(sce_exp,"counts"))
```

## Single-cell processing

```{r set-row-colnames}
colnames(sce_exp) <- paste0(sce_exp$sample_id, "_", sce_exp$ObjectNumber)
colnames(sce_cp_1) <- paste0(sce_cp_1$sample_id, "_", sce_cp_1$ObjectNumber)

rownames(sce_exp) <- rowData(sce_exp)$clean_target
rownames(sce_cp_1) <- rowData(sce_cp_1)$clean_target
```

**Transform counts**
Problem: Right-skewed distribution (bias from highly expressing cells)
Solution: Count transformation using an inverse hyperbolic sine function (arcsinh; common in flow cytometry) = leads to linear-like scale near zero and log-like scale beyond a threshold (`cofactor`)
We apply a `cofactor` of `1`.

```{r transform-counts, message=FALSE}
#Transformed counts
assay(sce_exp, "exprs") <- asinh(counts(sce_exp)/1)
assay(sce_cp_1, "exprs") <- asinh(counts(sce_cp_1)/1)
```

**Define interesting channels**

Subset markers of interest for downstream analysis.

```{r select-features}
rowData(sce_exp)$use_channel <- !grepl("DNA|H3", rowData(sce_exp)$clean_target)
rowData(sce_cp_1)$use_channel <- !grepl("DNA|H3", rowData(sce_cp_1)$clean_target)
```

## Segmentation quality control - B

Subset to ccRCC 

```{r}
sce_exp$subtype <- mcols(images)$subtype[match(sce_exp$sample_id, mcols(images)$sample_id)]
sce_cp_1$subtype <- mcols(images)$subtype[match(sce_cp_1$sample_id, mcols(images)$sample_id)]

sce_exp <- sce_exp[,!is.na(sce_exp$subtype)]
sce_exp_ccRCC <- sce_exp[,sce_exp$subtype == "clear_cell_RCC"]

sce_cp_1 <- sce_cp_1[,!is.na(sce_cp_1$subtype)]
sce_cp_1_ccRCC <- sce_cp_1[,sce_cp_1$subtype == "clear_cell_RCC"]
```

Heatmap based visualization

```{r segmentation-heatmap, message=FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=12}
set.seed(2201)
cur_cells <- sample(seq_len(ncol(sce_exp_ccRCC)), 5000)

dittoHeatmap(sce_exp_ccRCC[,cur_cells], genes = rownames(sce_exp_ccRCC)[rowData(sce_exp_ccRCC)$use_channel],
             assay = "exprs", cluster_cols = TRUE,scale = "none",
             heatmap.colors = viridis(100))

cur_cells_1 <- sample(seq_len(ncol(sce_cp_1_ccRCC)), 2000)
dittoHeatmap(sce_cp_1_ccRCC[,cur_cells_1], genes = rownames(sce_cp_1_ccRCC)[rowData(sce_cp_1_ccRCC)$use_channel],
             assay = "exprs", cluster_cols = TRUE,scale = "none",
             heatmap.colors = viridis(100))
```

Dimensionality reduction 

```{r}
### First for expansion masks 
sce <- sce_exp_ccRCC

## Subsample 10% of cells from each core
#to save time and not get super crowded dimensionality reduction plots
set.seed(22)
sub <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% group_by("sample_id") %>% slice_sample(prop = 0.1) %>% arrange("sample_id") %>% mutate(sub_id = paste(sample_id,ObjectNumber,sep="_")) %>% pull(sub_id)
sce_sub <- sce[,sub]

#Run UMAP/TSNE
sce_sub <- runUMAP(sce_sub[rowData(sce_sub)$use_channel,], n_neighbors = 30, pca = 50,exprs_values = "exprs", external_neighbors=TRUE, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam())
sce_sub <- runTSNE(sce_sub[rowData(sce_sub)$use_channel,], exprs_values = "exprs", external_neighbors=TRUE, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam())


## 1. Visualize TSNE
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD45RO_RA")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "SMA")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CA9")

plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD45RO_RA")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD8a")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD68")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD11b")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD163")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD16")

plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", colour_by = "sample_id")+
  guides(color = "none")

# Visualize all marker expression
all_plots_TSNE <- lapply(c(rownames(sce_sub)[rowData(sce_sub)$use_channel]),
                    function(x){
                      p <- plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", 
                                          colour_by = x, 
                                          by_exprs_values = "exprs",
                                          point_size = 0.5)+
                        guides(color = "none")+
                        ggtitle(paste0(x))
                      return(p)                    
                    })


## 2. Visualize UMAP
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD45RO_RA")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "SMA")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CA9")

plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD45RO_RA")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD8a")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD68")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD11b")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD163")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD16")

plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", colour_by = "sample_id")+
  guides(color = "none")

# Visualize all marker expression
all_plots_UMAP <- lapply(c(rownames(sce_sub)[rowData(sce_sub)$use_channel]),
                    function(x){
                      p <- plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", 
                                          colour_by = x, 
                                          by_exprs_values = "exprs",
                                          point_size = 0.5)+
                        guides(color = "none")+
                        ggtitle(paste0(x))
                      return(p)                    
                    })
```

**Key Conclusion:**
1. CellPose looks best (better dimensionality reduction plots and single-cell expression patterns) and will be used for downstream analysis.
